articleTitle: Three-dimensional Measurement and Defect Detection Method of Refractory Bricks Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Refractory bricks are refractory materials with a certain shape and size. The high temperature environment puts forward special requirements on the quality of refractory bricks. The size error, surface defects and internal structure must meet the corresponding quality standards. In recent years, the methods of applying machine vision to the surface quality inspection of refractory bricks have gradually increased. However, most of these methods focus on analysis of 2D images, ignoring the application of 3D information of refractory bricks. However, 3D information is important for getting the length, width, height, flatness of a refractory bricks and its missing corner detection. But if the 3D point cloud data of a refractory brick is directly used and processed, there are problems such as excessive calculation and low efficiency. In order to make the 3D information more efficiently used, a method based on PCA (Principle Component Analysis) for 3D size measurement and defect detection of refractory bricks is proposed. By using the proposed method, 3D parameters, such as length, width, height, can be accurately measured, while the 3D defects, such as missing corners, can be detected by a 2 D image processing method based on the dimensionality reduced data acquired by PCA. Therefore, the measurement and detection efficiency can be greatly improved for quality inspection of refractory bricks, so that actual production and application needs can be more easily met.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of 3D Gantry Crane Considering Rope Length Variation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of the economy, the control of harbor container cranes has attracted the attention of researchers. Tianjin Port is the first large comprehensive port in the north of China, the efficiency and work stability of port container cranes will directly affect the development of the port economy. In the face of market demand continues to large-scale, automation, and intelligent development, there is an urgent need to design a set of control methods suitable for port container cranes. To this end, this paper proposes a three-dimensional gantry crane system based on a sliding mode surface adaptive control method under the case of time-varying rope length and theoretically proves that the method can make the trolley arrive at the specified position quickly and accurately, and can effectively inhibit the load and the swing angle of the trolley through Lyapunov stability and Barbalat’s Lemma The effectiveness of the method is proven. Finally, the good performance of the method is proved by setting up a Simulink platform for a series of simulations and comparing it with the PD control method. The design concept of this control method can be widely applied to the design of other adaptive control methods.

articleTitle: Saturated Periodic Sliding Mode Control for Active Suspension Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper deals with the design of a periodic sliding mode control method for active suspension systems with control input constraint as well as unknown control direction. The periodic sliding mode control method is constructed to tackle the problem of unknown sign-switching control direction. In addition, the saturation functions are utilized to guarantee the control input can be always kept within the permitted range. By rigorous mathematical demonstration, the controlled system is Lyapunov stable while the tracking error is driven to 0. Simulations are utilized to show the effectiveness of the designed saturated periodic sliding mode control method.

articleTitle: Model Based Quadriceps Activation Strategy in Squat Training with Exhaustion Method Under Different Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore the muscle activation strategy of quadriceps muscle training in untrained sedentary people under different resistance training to exhaustion to provide control target for body state-based intelligence exercise equipment. Ten daily sedentary men with no training experience performed three sets of heavy load squats (single leg bench squat) in exhaustion mode (4RM) and one set of lower resistance squats (double leg squat with 10 KG garment) in exhaustion mode (18-26RM) to explore which and when the muscle fibers will be recruited as much as more. EMG signals from the dominant side of the vastus medialis), rectus femoris, and vastus lateralis in both squats were recorded, and the maximum RMS of 500 MS length in each movement was normalized to the maximum voluntary isometric contraction. Reliability analysis of the normalized EMG signal for each muscle between the three groups of heavy-load squats was as follows: Alpha (vastus medialis)= 0.885, Alpha (rectus femoris)=0.903, Alpha (vastus lateralis) = 0.925. Paired samples t-test of the three muscles under different resistance:p (vastus medialis) <0.001, p (rectus femoris) < 0.001, p (vastus lateralis) < 0.001. The EMG amplitude plateau occurred at the second or third times of heavy load exhaustion groups. The EMG amplitude plateau occurred in 53%-61% of exhaustion times in the lower resistance group. In conclusion, for quadriceps muscle training, 1) Muscle fibers activated by exhaustive training with small resistance are less than those activated by heavy weight training. 2) Quadriceps strength training, all muscle fibers can be activated before reaching the exhaustion number.

articleTitle: Pressure Ulcer Stage Evaluation Algorithm Based on Multi-Scale Attention Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Pressure ulcer, alternatively referred to as a pressure injury, mostly occurs in long-term bedridden patients. This issue has emerged as a significant global health concern. Accurate diagnosis is the key to the treatment of pressure sores in clinical application scenarios. Conventional contact-based artificial pressure ulcer detection methods can cause discomfort to patients and potentially elevate the risk of infection. In response to these problems, a pressure ulcer stage evaluation algorithm based on multi-scale attention residual network was proposed. The residual network was used as the basic framework, the stage 0 was improved to enhance the network’s nonlinear expressive capacity, and the residual structure was improved to enhanced the model’s generalization capability, the FPN feature pyramid was added to fuse the high-level features with the underlying features to achieve feature pyramid feature extraction. The incorporation of the attention mechanism enhanced the model’s overall performance and recognition accuracy. The pressure damage stage dataset was used in an experiment to validate the model’s performance. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the proposed method could achieve the precision, recall, F1-score and accuracy of the algorithm of $82.64 \%, 83.26 \%, 0.83$ and 82.37% respectively. Compared with other deep learning models, this proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy and identify the pressure ulcer effectively.

articleTitle: End-to-end Remote Sensing Image Matching based on Deep Feature Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Matching between remote sensing images is one of the basic problems of earth observation. Addressing the challenge of matching difficulties arising from the complexity of surface information and the diverse scales of objects in remote sensing images, an end-to-end remote sensing image matching method (DFL-Net) based on deep feature learning is proposed. The network consists of two main components: a multi-scale keypoint detection network and a feature descriptor extraction network. Firstly, this paper proposes Score importance ranking loss (SIR-Loss) and Descriptor importance ranking loss (DIR-Loss) to ensure high repeatability and distinguishability of keypoints that improve the accuracy of image matching. Secondly, In the multi-scale keypoint detection network, a feature pyramid-based convolution method is designed to fuse multi-scale features at different network layers. Within the same layer, multiple convolution kernels are gradually expanded to capture a more comprehensive range of information in remote sensing images. Additionally, a channel-spatial attention mechanism is employed to aggregate response maps from the keypoint detection network to identify keypoints with significant scores. In addition, a large number of remote sensing images are collected to produce a dataset. Finally, the remote sensing image matching network proposed in this paper is experimentally verified to have excellent results in feature matching.

articleTitle: Constructing an Intelligent Streetlight Control System Based on Edge-Cloud Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the ever-evolving landscape of global urban development, the paradigm of urban smartification stands out as a pivotal trend. Among its key components, smart streetlights have emerged as focal points, drawing increasing attention and substantial investments from a growing number of cities. These streetlights transcend their traditional role as mere illumination fixtures, evolving into sophisticated systems seamlessly integrated with cutting-edge technologies. The significance of advancing smart streetlight infrastructure extends beyond efficient road lighting; it is a catalyst for enhancing the sustainability and intelligence of cities. By leveraging various advanced technologies, smart streetlights offer multifaceted benefits, bolstering support and services for crucial urban functions such as traffic management, environmental protection, and security. Consequently, the research and development of smart streetlights have gained recognition, establishing itself as a pivotal direction in the broader landscape of urban smartification. This article focuses on a specific facet of this paradigm—the establishment of a smart management system for smart streetlights. Taking a proactive approach, it introduces a method involving the intelligent networking of devices to the cloud. This innovative approach not only paves the way for seamless integration but also presents a concrete and viable solution for the swift integration of Internet of Things (IoT) devices into the urban network.

articleTitle: SMILES-ANN for Vapor-liquid Phase Equilibrium Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Both the pretreatment of raw materials (mixtures) and the separation of products and by-products of products require the use of phase equilibrium properties as a theoretical basis. The current thermodynamic equations used for phase equilibrium calculations are often affected by their own system limitations and the complexity of parameter estimation when performing phase equilibrium calculations. In order to weaken the system limitations and computational complexity of the thermodynamic equations, this paper designs the SMILES-ANN model for the prediction of vapor-liquid phase equilibrium, and in order to test the performance of the model, the constant temperature and pressure phase equilibrium dataset of an alcoholic system, which contains about 5,000 data points, is produced, and the bubble point temperature/pressure and dew point temperature/pressure are computed by the model on the dataset. The final predicted mean absolute errors (MAE) for pressure and temperature at equilibrium were 0.0098 and 0.0093, respectively, and the corresponding molar fraction errors for the liquid and gas phases were $\mathbf{0.0480}$ and $\mathbf{0.0393}$.

articleTitle: Sampled-data Synchronization of Quaternion-valued Neural Networks by Non-decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper studies sampled-data control of quaternion-valued neural networks(QVNNs) with variable sampling, based on the quaternion matrices nondecomposition method. Firstly, the synchronization error model of quaternion-valued neural networks is established. Then, by adopting a refined input delay approach, and structuring a discontinuous Lyapunov function, the quaternion-valued LMI synchronization criteria for QVNNs are obtained. Furthermore, the proposed quaternion-valued LMIs are transformed into complexvalued LMIs equivalently. In addition, the event-trigger synchronization criteria are easily obtained by introducing the event-trigger scheme. Finally, the obtained results are demonstrated by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Switch Threshold Event-triggered Control for Path Following of Underactuated Surface Vessels
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The paper focuses on the issue of path-following for underactuated surface vessels. Initially, the Line of sight (LOS) guidance method is harnessed for convert the pathfollowing objective into tracking the desired heading angle. Neural networks are called upon to estimate the nonlinear functions within the ship model, and a path following controller is designed based on the backstepping method. Due to the shortcomings inherent in both fixed threshold and relative threshold strategies, this paper introduces a switching threshold event-triggered strategy for the designed control law. The switching threshold strategy combines the fixed threshold strategy and the relative threshold strategy. When the control signal is small, the control strategy is relative threshold strategy, ensuring precise control and system stability. When the control signal is large, the control strategy switches to the fixed threshold strategy to avoid significant control errors and ensure tracking performance. Therefore, the switching threshold strategy combines the advantages of both the fixed threshold and relative threshold strategies, striking a balance between system performance and network constraints. Through Lyapunov’s theory analysis, it is proven that the system is asymptotically bounded, effectively avoiding Zeno phenomenon. Finally, a comparison with simulation charts and data from fixed threshold and relative threshold strategies illustrates the superiority of the proposed switching threshold strategy.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator Considering Control Parameter and Structural Parameter
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In order to improve the power generation performance of permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), this paper proposes an optimization method that can simultaneously optimize the structural parameter and control parameter of PMSG. Firstly, iron dissipation resistance and current angle (the angle between the current synthesis vector is and the q axis) are introduced into the loss model, specific expressions for electromagnetic loss are derived on the basis of this loss model, and the PMSG control model based on current angle is constructed in simulation platform, and the effect of current angle on electromagnetic loss is analyzed. Secondly, a multi-objective optimization model with electromagnetic loss and total PMSG mass as the optimization objectives is established, and the control parameter current angle and seven structural parameters are used as the optimization variables, and the optimization variables are subjected to sensitivity analysis. Finally, the Kriging agent model was chosen to construct the mapping relationship between the optimization variables and the optimization objective to approximate the replacement of the finite element model, and the Pareto front was obtained by using NSGA-II, besides, the operational performances before and after PMSG optimization are compared by simulation experiments, and the results prove that the electromagnetic loss and the total mass of the motor are effectively reduced.

articleTitle: A Non-Singular Terminal Sliding Mode Controller for Rigid Spacecraft Attitude Tracking under Actuator Failures and Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of finite-time attitude tracking control for rigid spacecrafts with actuator faults and attacks. Firstly a fast non-singular terminal sliding mode control method is proposed to avoid singularity. Then, the controller based on sliding mode control is designed to solve the spacecraft attitude tracking problem. In the presence of actuator faults and attacks, this technique can make the attitude and angular velocity tracking errors converge in a finite time, and any small bound centered on the equilibrium point converges, and then asymptotically reaches the equilibrium point, ensuring the stability of the spacecraft. This control has the advantages of fast convergence, high accuracy, strong robustness, and easy implementation. Finally, under the multiple constraints of actuator failures and attacks, external disturbances, and inertial uncertainties, the finite-time convergence of the spacecraft attitude tracking system is proved by Lyapunov stability theory, and the good performance of the proposed controller is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Phase Equilibrium Prediction Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Vapor-liquid equilibrium (VLE) data is one of the most important pieces of information for process equipment design and operating unit simulation. Since it is not possible to perform the experiment completely in all possible operating temperature and pressure ranges, other methods are needed to calculate the required VLE data. In recent years, the development of data-driven models such as artificial neurons, random forests, and multilayer perceptron has pioneered new directions in phase equilibrium data prediction. In this paper, a method based on graph neural networks (GNNs) is proposed to predict the liquid phase distribution for vapor-liquid phase equilibrium. The liquid phase distribution is modeled as a normal distribution with the mean as the predicted value and the variance corresponding to the confidence in the results, resulting in a stable prediction. Vapor-liquid two-phase molecules in phase equilibrium serve as two molecular diagrams. We distinguish between different molecules by the characteristics of the atoms and bonds in different molecules and this is used as an input along with temperature and pressure. The model is trained and predicted by deterministic learning and inference. The accuracy of the method is verified by actual experimental data. We drew a phase equilibrium graph based on the predicted data and the real data, and the MAE and RMSE evaluation indexes were controlled within a small range.

articleTitle: An Automated Measurement Method for Deformity Parameters Required for Taylor Spatial Frame Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: An clinical practice, obtaining accurate deformity parameters of the bone is crucial for Taylor spatial frame correction of tibial deformities. The accuracy of these parameters directly affects the precision of the generated correction prescription and the success rate of the surgery. Manual measurement procedures are cumbersome, often requiring tools such as rulers and auxiliary lightboxes. Additionally, due to the constraints of two-dimensional measurements, it can be challenging to capture standard X-rays that meet the requirements in some situations. Three-dimensional automated measurements, to a certain extent, overcome the limitations arising from insufficiently favorable objective shooting conditions. Moreover, the automation of the measurement process is more advanced. To address these challenges, this study proposes an automated system for measuring tibial deformities specifically tailored for Taylor spatial frame correction. Firstly, a bone point cloud segmentation network is developed, which takes labeled tibial point clouds as input and predicts key feature points. Subsequently, the fitted tibial shaft axis is obtained by fitting these segmented feature points from multiple angles. Based on the fitting results, the deformity parameters required for Taylor spatial frame correction are computed. The measurement results obtained through this method demonstrate a high level of precision in orthopedics and significantly alleviate the workload of physicians.

articleTitle: V10Drone: Improved YOLOv10 with KAN for Small Object Detection in Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Object detection in aerial robots like small UAVs and drones are extensively applied in both military and civilian applications.However, accurate object detection remains challenging due to the high resolution and small object scales in drone-captured images. In this paper, an efficient and lightweight network V10Drone is proposed, and it is specifically designed for small object detection in aerial robots. Three key improvements are introduced to the network in detail. Firstly, convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) layers are integrated into the backbone to improve feature extraction. Secondly, a bridge module is incorporated between the backbone and the neck to minimize loss in transmission of features. Thirdly, a new lightweight four-layer neck is redesigned by two different upsample and downsample modules to improve two abilities of multiscale feature fusion and small object detection. Experiments on the VisDrone dataset demonstrate that V10Drone achieves mAP50 of 43.4% and mAP of 36.3%, and these results exceed the baseline of the YOLOv10s model by 4.9% and 3.3%, respectively. In addition, V10Drone exhibits higher accuracy than the M-scale model.

articleTitle: ESRTMDet: Robust Recognition of Industrial 2D Barcodes in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In industrial production, barcode technology is essential for enhancing product quality and managing production processes. However, in complex environments, factors such as illumination changes, blurring, and occlusion can significantly reduce the recognition accuracy of industrial 2D barcodes, particularly QR codes and DataMatrix codes. Existing methods often fall short under these challenging conditions. This study proposes an algorithm named Enhanced Super-Resolution for Real-Time Object Detection (ESRTMDet) to improve the recognition performance of industrial 2D barcodes in such environments. The proposed method utilizes a high-quality dataset of complex scenes, carefully annotated and preprocessed. An improved RTMDet network is employed for barcode detection, with enhancements such as large kernel depth convolutions, dynamic soft label assignment, and classifier optimization, leading to notable performance improvements. Detected barcode images are then processed using an optimized ESRGAN super-resolution network to remove noise and enhance details. Finally, efficient decoding is achieved using WeChatQRCode, ZXing, and libdmtx libraries. Experimental results show that ESRTMDet achieves a mean average precision (mAP) of 99.25%, a localization detection rate of 99.62%, a decoding success rate of 96.49%, and a processing speed of 25.64 frames per second in complex environments, outperforming traditional methods. These results demonstrate the algorithm’s robustness and precision, making it highly suitable for industrial inspection and product traceability applications, where it significantly enhances barcode recognition accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control Strategy with Guaranteed Transient Performance for Double Pendulum Cranes
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a control strategy with guaranteed transient performance for double pendulum crane systems. This control strategy not only completes the control objectives, but also improves the convergence performance. First, applying the prescribed performance bound (PPB) technology, the state variable errors of the system are transformed. This technology can eliminate the steady static errors and guarantee transient performance. This technology enables the trolley to reach the specified desired position quickly, and limits the first and second pendulum angles, ensuring the safety performance of the system. Then, in the controller design, more swing angle information is used as feedbacks. In this way, the first and second pendulum angles are restrained, the double pendulum effect is solved. So, this way improves the safety of the system. The stability analysis proves that the errors of the system state variables can reach a very small neighborhood of zero with the specified exponential speed according to prescribed performance bound technology. Finally, the simulation results validate that this control strategy achieves the control objectives, restrains the first and second pendulum angles, and ensures the transient performances of the system.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv7 Model with SimAM for Wind Turbine Blade Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Traditional wind turbine blade defects detection methods, mainly based on strain measurement, acoustic wave analyse, ultrasound, thermography phenomenon, and so on. However, these measure methods usually has common faults in low recognition accuracy and weak detection ability for small targets in complex backgrounds. In order to tackle with above critical problems, this paper proposes a high-accuracy model which is based on the YOLOv7 network. First, Offline data augmentation methods are used to boost the images numbers of dataset and simulate the defects of WTBs (Wind Turbine Blades) in complex background. Moreover, the size of bounding box for each images in datasets made by this paper is counted. The result is that the number of defects with small size in the dataset is the highest, according to the definition of small object given by COCO dataset. In addition, the effectiveness of online data augmentation approaches is analysed in ablation experiment. Moreover, to improve the YOLOv7 model detection accuracy in small size WTBs, the SimAM (Simple Attention module) is introduced to the neck portion of the YOLOv7 model. The experimental results demonstrate a significant improvement in various detection metrics with the improved YOLOv7 model, effectively reducing occasions of missed detections and false detections.

articleTitle: Optimization of Fracture Reduction Robot Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of fracture reduction, combining inverse kinematic analysis with robot dynamics modelling might lead to a more effective controller for the fracture reduction process. The trajectory of the actuator driving rod’s motion and any deviations from it are calculated using Simulink simulation. The Levy-SSA-optimized fracture reduction robot’s positioning inaccuracy is two orders of magnitude lower than the PID adjustment approach. Using this method also improves the reduction trajectory’s accuracy and speeds up the convergence of the fracture-resetting robot control system to the ideal solution.

articleTitle: TFFT-Net: A Hybrid CNN-Transformer Approach for Time-Frequency Feature Fusion in Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The industrial field environment is subject to dynamic fluctuations, yet deep learning models are typically trained on historical data, which may reduce their effectiveness in new contexts. This research introduces a Transformer-based temporal correlation embedding transfer learning approach to address the widespread issue of domain shift in bearing fault diagnosis. Specifically, the study presents a temporal correlation extraction module based on Transformer architecture, designed to capture sequential dependencies within vibration signals. Additionally, a multi-objective decomposition classifier is proposed to integrate and classify features across various spatial domains. The proposed methodology has shown superior performance in bearing fault diagnosis tasks, thereby demonstrating the algorithm’s efficacy and superiority.

articleTitle: Research on Output Characteristics of Switched Reluctance Generator Based on Finite Element Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: A finite element model of a switched reluctance generator is established in ANSYS software. The transient characteristics of the switched reluctance generator are simulated, and the influence of structural parameters such as stator embrace, rotor embrace, stator yoke thickness, and winding turns, as well as control parameters such as initial excitation voltage, speed, turn-on angle, and turn off angle on the output characteristics of the switched reluctance generator are analyzed. This provides a basis for parameter optimization and actual operation control of the switched reluctance generator.

articleTitle: STR-AF: An Adversarial Monitoring Framework with Spatial-temporal Representation and Adaptive Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The structure of modern industrial processes has become increasingly complex. Multiple sensors are placed in the system to obtain their operating status. From a spatial perspective, different process variables experience complex interactions through control loops. And because of process dynamics, the variables usually have a temporal characteristic. Often, these two dependencies have different manifestations, indicating different process characteristics. However, the existing methods can not separate spatial and temporal information well, which leads to inaccurate process monitoring performance, and the existing methods still have problems such as model collapse, poor generalization ability and poor accuracy. Therefore, a spatial-temporal representation and adaptive fusion adversarial monitoring framework (STR-AF) is proposed to deal with spatial-temporal characteristics, so as to better identify industrial process faults. Specifically, three different encoders are built to process temporal, spatial, and global information respectively, and integrate the three features organically. Finally, the two decoders are trained against each other to optimize the model. The effectiveness of STR-AF method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Novel Indoor Positioning Algorithm Using Bluetooth Beacon Based on Improved Trilateration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Nowadays, society has entered the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), where achieving the transition from the interconnection of everything to the intelligent interconnection of everything requires precise position information for both people and objects. Therefore, positioning technology has become a popular research topic across various fields. Currently, indoor positioning technology faces significant challenges, such as high costs and low accuracy, especially in complex indoor environments. Low-Energy Bluetooth (BLE) stands out due to its advantages like broad bandwidth and long communication distance, making low-cost, high-precision BLE indoor positioning a reality. Therefore, this paper utilizes the polyfit function to fit the log-distance path loss curve in actual indoor environments for distance estimation. It proposes a novel indoor positioning algorithm using Bluetooth beacon, which utilizes the least square method to refine the coordinates measured by the original trilateration method to improve the positioning accuracy. The experimental results show that compared with the ordinary trilateration algorithm, the positioning accuracy of the least square positioning algorithm is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Leader-Following Consensus of Positive Multi-Agent Systems With Hybrid Gain Performances
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the fault detection and leaderfollowing consensus issues in positive multi-agent systems. By using the output information and the matrix decomposition technique, a novel framework on hybrid $L_{1} / L_{-}$filter and consensus protocol are designed. Then, an augmented fault detection system is established and a linear threshold is constructed for the judgement index based on 1 -norm. Under these conditions, copositive Lyapunov function is utilized to ensure the stability of multi-agent systems with hybrid $L_{1} / L_{-}$performance. Moreover, all conditions are formulated in the form of linear programming. Lastly, an example is provided to demonstrate the validity of the findings.

articleTitle: A Classification Study of Alzheimer’s Disease Based on Siamese Residual Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder that causes memory loss and cognitive decline, heavily burdening patients, families, and healthcare systems. Its prevalence is rising with the aging global population. Therefore, early diagnosis and intervention of AD has become an important area of public health research. To achieve this goal, we propose a Siamese Residual network (S-Resnet) architecture that uses a contrast loss function to transform input MRI images into k-dimensional embedding, and uses these embedded representations in the classification prediction of AD as well as mild cognitive impairment. The validity of the model was tested using the ADNI dataset containing 514 subjects with 103 AD, 116 late mild cognitive impairment (LMCI), 145 early mild cognitive impairment (EMCI) and 150 normal controls (NC). The classification accuracy of our framework was ${9 2. 2 0 \%}$ for AD vs NC, ${9 0. 2 7 \%}$ for LMCI vs NC, and ${8 7. 6 5 \%}$ for EMCI vs NC. The results obtained were also compared with other competitive methods.

articleTitle: Adaptive Stabilization Control for Second-order Strict Feedback System with Quantized Input via Fully Actuated System Method
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper focuses on investigating the issue of adaptive fuzzy stabilization control for a specific class of uncertain second-order strict feedback system with quantized input via fully actuated system method. In order to deal with second-order systems directly and efficiently, we take the fully actuated system method. It is unnecessary to convert the second-order system into the first-order system, thereby significantly reducing the computational load. To effectively overcome the challenges posed by quantized input, the decomposition of hysteresis quantizer is used. It can effectively suppress high-frequency noise and deal with power reduction, and has good dynamic response characteristics. Moreover, it can greatly reduce the cost and is suitable for many low-cost, high-performance real-time control systems. To deal with the uncertainty in the system, fuzzy logic system technology is adopted, and the calculation amount is reduced by tunning function to avoid the occurrence of over-parametrization phenomenon and make the controller have good stability. The proposed quantization controller ensures that all signals in the closed-loop system remain bounded, thereby achieving stabilization control. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are further demonstrated through simulations on the single-link robot arm model. This paper offers a viable solution to the control issues in systems with uncertainty and quantized input.

articleTitle: Development of An Automated Data Analysis Program in Python on the Influence of Extracts on Changes in Lipofuscin Content in the C. Elegans Organism
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This study focuses on developing a Python program and algorithm for regression analysis to screen plantderived extracts with geroprotective properties. The Python 3.9 program generates dependencies of characteristics based on input data. Regression analysis utilizes data measuring lipofuscin autofluorescence at $340 / 420 \mathrm{~nm}$ in C. elegans after 5 and 15 days of treatment with extracts (Ginkgo biloba, St. John’s wort, Baikal skullcap, forgotten pennyroyal, and true ginseng) at 10, 100, and 1000 -fold dilutions. Polynomial regression reveals data spread, with determination coefficients near 1 indicating a small spread and close to 0 indicating a large one. A significant scatter in measurements for the same extract and dilution may signal measurement errors. Increasing polynomial degree enhances accuracy until the second degree; further increases lead to decreasing determination coefficients. The regression analysis program predicts changes in lipofuscin autofluorescence post-treatment, aiding in evaluating medicinal plant extracts under varied experimental conditions. The developed automatic regression analysis program enables predicting changes in lipofuscin autofluorescence after treatment with medicinal plant extracts across diverse experimental settings.

articleTitle: From Segmentation to Generation: the Emerging Trends in Skin Lesion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Skin disease detection has undergone significant advancements with the advent of deep learning-based image segmentation techniques. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive overview of the evolution of skin disease detection, from traditional methods to modernapproaches. We discuss the role of U-Net and its variants in medical image segmentation, highlighting their improved performance and robustness through multi-scale features, multi-task learning, and attention mechanisms. Additionally, we explore the recent trend of generation-based methods, including generative adversarial networks and diffusion models, which have shown promising results in generating high-quality skin disease segmentation masks. We also review popular skin disease segmentation datasets and evaluation metrics,and present experimental results comparing the performance of various models. As deep learning continues to advance and skin disease datasets expand, we anticipate the emergence of innovative network architectures and technologies that will further improve the diagnosis and treatment of skin diseases. This paper aims to inspire future research in this direction, exploring the potential of generation-based methods for skin disease detection and paving the way for more accurate and efficient diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Consensus of Discrete-Time Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper studies the finite-time consensus of discrete-time multi-agent systems (MASs). First, a regionconditional switching controller is developed to realize finitetime consensus problem of the discrete-time system. Under this scheme, the controller is divided into two modes of operation, and whether or not the controller makes switching depends on a predetermined region condition. The study of finite-time consensus can achieve consistency by reducing the consumption of communication and computational resources. Compared with the existing results, the scheme realizes the complete consensus of the discrete-time system. It improves control performance and reduces excessive consumption of control resources. Then, the concept of finite-time consensus is introduced in discrete-time MASs to describe the control performance by the settling time function. The finite-time consensus criterion is obtained by constructing the Lyapunov function, and the settling time is obtained by solving difference fractional and linear matrix inequality. Finally, the validity of the method is verified through numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Diagnosis Model for Rehabilitation Training Prescription for Spinal Cord Injury Patients Based on Multi-label Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) is a serious complication that occurs after a spinal fracture. It is the key to prescribe rehabilitation training according to the condition of patients. Therefore, this research proposed a diagnostic model for rehabilitation training prescription for SCI patients based on multi-label classification. Firstly, a data set of electronic medical records of 1441 SCI patients was constructed, and the data prediction processing was completed. By effectively utilizing the correlation between labels, the performance of multi-label classification models can be greatly improved, thereby increasing the diagnosis accuracy of SCI rehabilitation training prescription. We improved the classifier chain algorithm by calculating the influence of labels to determine the order of label chains, and then using mutual information to optimize the learning features of the base classifier to predict the rehabilitation prescriptions for patients. Compared with other improved algorithms, the model shows significant improvements in many metrics. Its hamming loss and ranking loss were 0.2104 and 0.3402, and precision, recall, and F1-score were ${8 0. 2 9 \%}$, 76.25%, and 76.23% respectively. In clinical treatment, this model can provide valuable diagnostic information for the clinical treatment of SCI patients, assist medical professionals and physicians in better clinical diagnosis, and enhances the reliability of clinical decisions.

articleTitle: Construction Vehicle Detection Model Based on Bidirectional-path Cosine Self-attention Feature Pyramid Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The safety of power grid is easy to be influenced by the mobile operation of construction vehicles under overhead transmission lines. Detection of construction vehicles around transmission channels can effectively ensure the safety of power supply. In object detection, it will lead to the loss of small weak parts and the confusion of similar features if the features of different depths are fused without processing. A construction vehicle detection model based on bidirectionalpath cosine self-attention feature pyramid network (BPCSAFPN) is proposed in this paper. Based on the original feature pyramid network, a bidirectional-path feature pyramid network (BP-FPN) is constructed by adding a bottom-up path feature pyramid network in parallel. The bottom-up feature fusion path can better integrate shallow features and deep semantic features together to represent multi-scale features. To suppress the redundant background information and noise interference introduced in the feature fusion, a cosine selfattention network (CSA) is added after feature fusion in the feature pyramid. Experiments show that the detection effect of construction vehicle detection model proposed in this paper is better than that of YOLO series, Faster RCNN and other detection models, with AP value reaching 83.4%, which can suppress background information, effectively integrate multiscale features and achieve good detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Control of Levitating Sphere System Based on Virtual Prototype
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The magnetic levitation system has a wide application background in industry, transportation and other fields. But the system is more complex and has strong nonlinear. The suspension sphere system is a simplified model of magnetic levitation system, so deepening the understanding of the suspension sphere system is of great help to the study of magnetic levitation system. In order to advance the understanding of levitating sphere systems, this study employs the creation of virtual prototypes to facilitate a comprehensive exploration of the system. Firstly, an exhaustive analysis of the entire system is undertaken, leading to the formulation of a mathematical model which then undergoes a process of linearization. Leveraging virtual prototype technology, the subsequent phase includes the precise modeling of the levitating sphere system. A co-simulation is executed in SIMULINK thereafter, and build a sliding mode control law to manage the levitation gap within the system. Finally, the study concludes by juxtaposing the newly designed strategy with a traditional PID control, conducting a critical analysis of both the feasibility and efficacy of the implemented control strategy. The results show that compared with the system using PID control, the system using sliding mode control can reach the set suspension position faster, so the response speed is faster, and the system can return to the equilibrium position faster after interference, so the anti-interference ability is strong.

articleTitle: Fall Monitoring System for the Elderly by Integrating Multi-Sensor and Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Falling has become an important safety hazard in the life of the elderly. Aiming at the problems such as uncertain fall Angle threshold and inaccurate fall judgment in the elderly, this paper proposes a new fall monitoring strategy for the elderly by utilizing the synergistic effect of multiple sensors such as posture, heart rate and blood oxygen. The random forest algorithm is used to select the number of samples and the optimal attributes to realize the accurate recognition of complex poses. After debugging and running tests, the fall angle threshold becomes clear. The design program and cloud platform realize the visualization of fall angle data, improve the accuracy of fall determination, and can monitor the heart rate, blood oxygen and other data parameters of the elderly in real time. The experimental results show that this strategy can effectively and accurately monitor the fall angle. Compared with the traditional fall monitoring system, the determination of the angle data threshold is optimized, which is conducive to ensuring the life safety of the elderly, and has important application significance for promoting the intelligent life of the elderly and improving the quality of life.

articleTitle: Optic Disk and Cup Segmentation Using Dual Branch and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of blindness and is difficult to diagnose due to its insidious onset and lack of unique features. The cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) is crucial for glaucoma diagnosis and requires accurate segmentation of the optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC). However, the similarity between background regions and OD/OC complicates this task, thus reducing segmentation accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a dual-branch segmentation network that uses transformer techniques to improve OD and OC segmentation accuracy. Our model consists of the first branch, an identification module (IM), which reduces noise in low-level features and refines detail extraction via an attention mechanism. Meanwhile, the second branch, a scale-aware feature fusion module (SCA-FFM), integrates semantic and location data from high-level features. The outputs of these modules are combined via a graph convolutional domain-feature fusion module (GCD-FFM) to produce feature maps that capture both global and local details. Empirical results demonstrate the superior accuracy and generalization ability of our model.

articleTitle: Pain Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved Xception and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Efficient and accurate pain assessment is crucial for diagnosing medical conditions. To improve the accuracy of pain assessment, a pain expression recognition algorithm based on improved Xception and attention mechanism was proposed. A facial pain expression acquisition platform was built to extract video frame sequences and establish a pain expression database. Xception was used as the backbone network. Skip connections were added to enhance the extraction and utilization of shallow features. Multi-scale convolution module was designed to extract richer facial features. Relu was replaced by the Leaky Relu activation function. Attention mechanism was introduced to enhance important features. The model was verified on the pain expression database. The results illustrated the superiority of the proposed model, achieving an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 5. 2} \%$, which effectively identifies pain more than other basic deep learning models.

articleTitle: A Parking Space Arrangement Algorithm Based On the Agent Behavior Guidance and PER-D3QN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The rapid increase in car ownership in China has led to a shortage of ground parking resources. Underground parking offers a viable solution but presents challenges due to inconsistent specifications and numerous design parameters. Current automated algorithms fail to arrange parking spaces effectively and inexpensively. In this study, we propose a parking layout algorithm based on agent behaviour guidance and PER-D3QN. First, we establish a reinforcement learning model and define the environment, state space, action space, and optimization objectives. Subsequently, we employ the PER-D3QN algorithm to achieve the objectives based on our model. We also design a reward function that includes a car function guided by agent behavior and a traffic function with three indicators. This reward function enables the algorithm to optimize parking layouts in various scenarios, such as straight roads, turns, and environments with obstacles like pillars. Furthermore, we developed a consistent perspective-based network structure. Finally, comparative experiments are conducted with other algorithms using 6 different standard CAD engineering drawings. The results show that the algorithm handles large-scale complex obstacle layouts effectively, offering more flexible road and parking arrangements compared to predefined zoning. Future research will explore optimizing layouts with multiple entrances, exits, and more dynamic multi-directional movement strategies.

articleTitle: An Improved Observer-based Security Estimation Scheme for Networked Control Systems with Deception Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: A networked control systems (NCSs) with deception attacks is studied in this paper. Considering the energy constraints, the deception attacks are assumed to be bounded. To weaken the negative impact of deception attacks, an estimation method based on an improved observer is propose. In the proposed estimation method, the lagging nature of the observer is utilized to delay the effect of deception attacks on the controller. Based on this scheme, conditions ensuring the stability of the system and guiding the design of the controller gains have been laid out, respectively. Ultimately, the accuracy of the theoretical findings is verified via numerical illustrations.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Prefractionation Column Using Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Crude oil refining is an important part of the chemical industry. The separation of different components in crude oil is realized by distillation columns. To optimize distillation columns, operating variables need to be set properly. Heuristic optimization algorithms are suitable for a variety of optimization problems, and more easily extended to large-scale optimization problems. The firefly algorithm is inspired by the luminescence and attraction behavior of fireflies in nature. In order to solve the problem that standard firefly algorithm is easy to fall into a local optimum, a dynamic switching strategy is introduced to the new improved firefly algorithm. The location update strategy could dynamically switch between focus on global optimization and local optimization. The switch is triggered by the consecutive generation times of unchanged optimal value of objective function. The improved firefly algorithm is implemented to optimize a prefractionation column which is modelled from a real refinery using Aspen Plus and MATLAB, and its performance is compared with standard firefly algorithm.

articleTitle: FCSA: An ARM+FPGA-based Software and Hardware Collaboration DNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The parallel architecture of FPGAs is well suited for parallel computation of DNNs. However, softmax-layer is one of the core operators of DNNs, which contains exponentiation and division operations and is not suitable for implementation on FPGAs. In this paper, we design an ARM+FPGA-based software and hardware collaboration DNN classifier (FCSA). The DNN classifier consists of a fully-connected layer and a softmax-layer. FPGA performs the full-connected-layer operations, ARM performs the softmax-layer operations. The FPGA and ARM interact with data through AXI-Stream. Fashion-MNIST dataset is used as test data. The experiments are carried out on ZYNQ7020 and ZU4EV. The result show that ZYNQ7020 processes each image in 206.44us and 1.701 W power consumption and ZU4EV processes each image in 84.3us and 3.385W power consumption.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control Method for Offshore Cranes Based on Differential Fatness
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: As important working equipment on the sea, offshore cranes play an important role in a series of activities at sea. Offshore crane is a kind of mechanical equipment specially used for lifting materials at sea. It is widely used in ports, ships, marine engineering and other fields. It is used for loading and unloading goods, installing equipment, maritime rescue, scientific research and detection tasks. In ship operation, due to the complexity of the marine environment and the instability of the hull, the lifting operation is often affected by the ship excitation and wind load, and the lifting load is prone to swing, which brings difficulties and risks to the operation and cargo transportation. Under the influence of interference such as sea waves, the payload of offshore cranes is prone to large swing in the process of transportation. If not controlled, it will cause adverse effects. It is very important to realize the accurate positioning of payloads in special application environment. Therefore, this paper proposes an active disturbance rejection control method for offshore cranes based on differential flatness technique. Specifically, the coupling problem of the system is solved by differential flatness technique, and effective flat outputs are constructed. Then, we design an active disturbance rejection controller using the constructed flat outputs. The expressions of the relationship between the flat outputs and the state variables can be calculated. Finally, in order to verify whether the method is true and effective, and can achieve the desired objectives, we conduct a set of simulation tests.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Control of Variable Load Drone Based on HOFA System Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper proposes an integral sliding controller based on second-order fully actuated system theory for the control problem of variable load six rotor unmanned aerial vehicles in the event of flight faults, and an extended observer with model information is used to estimate and compensate for the fault signals which occur during the flight. This paper innovatively introduces virtual control variables to supplement the system into a second-order six dimensional fully actuated system, and designs an integral sliding mode controller using a modified saturation function to achieve rapid stability of unmanned aerial vehicles during the process of verying load. In addition, the extended observer can also successfully estimate and compensate for the loss of execution efficiency of the drone.

articleTitle: Modeling Pedestrian Dynamics Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: A reinforcement learning-based pedestrian dynamics model is proposed in this paper. A pedestrian is defined as an agent that contains information about its own state, the distance between the pedestrian and the exit, and the distance to other pedestrians or surrounding obstacles. In order to solve the problems of pedestrians avoiding collisions and evacuating to the exit at an appropriate speed, a reward function is designed based on factors such as the Reciprocal Velocity Obstacle area and the pedestrian’s distance to the exit. The model is trained using BiGRU based neural network, and the LN method is used for data normalization to speed up the training process. Based on the established model, the clogging phenomenon at the exit, the relationship between speed and the number of pedestrians, and the crowd evacuation behavior when there is an obstacle at the exit are simulated. The experimental results are consistent with existing research and verify the effectiveness of the model to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution with RCAN for Improved Malaria Cell Classification: A Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This study investigates the use of Residual Channel Attention Networks (RCAN) for $2 x$ super-resolution in malaria cell imaging to enhance the diagnostic capabilities of image classification models. While foundational for malaria diagnosis, traditional microscopy techniques often yield variable results contingent upon the operator’s proficiency. RCAN was employed to upscale the resolution of malaria cell images, allowing for the extraction of more detailed and detectable features. Super- resolution effectiveness was quantitatively assessed using the Peak Signal Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index Mea- sure (SSIM). Post-super-resolution, a comprehensive horizontal comparison of multiple classification models was conducted using both the original and enhanced datasets to demonstrate the superiority of super-resolved images in improving classification accuracy. The model that exhibited the best performance was further analyzed to provide interpretability insights through confusion matrix, precision-recall curves, ROC analysis, F1- Score, and visualization of semantic features. This analysis not only underscored the enhanced accuracy

articleTitle: Object Detection of Construction Machinery around Power Transmission Line Based on Spatial Feature Fusion Network and the Technology of Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: It is of great significance to accurately detect objects, such as construction machinery around the power transmission line, that risk damaging the power transmission line and measure the distance between objects and the power transmission line to ensure the safety of the power transmission line. When different depth features are fused without processing, object detection can lead to the loss of small, weak parts and the confusion of similar features. Firstly, this paper proposed a Spatial feature fusion network (SFF Net), which used Darknet53 as the backbone to extract features and a PAFPN-like structure to process features. Secondly, a Shallow spatial feature fusion (SSFF) module was proposed in this paper to replace the feature fusion structure in the original PAN. In particular, an interactive projection system was designed to project shallow space information in the deep semantic information effectively. Finally, we proposed an object location method of external damage risk of transmission line construction machinery based on object detection and binocular vision, which could measure the distance between construction machinery and the power transmission line. The experiment on the construction machinery dataset shows that the value of AP0.5 reaches 80.9% and the value of AP0.5-0.95 reaches 51.4%, which is better than the current advanced method. The distance measurement technology achieves good results and guarantees the safety of power transmission lines.

articleTitle: Analysis of Max-Plus Algebraic Model for Intelligent Manufacturing Systems Based on Heap Method
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Max-plus algebra is a mathematical method with special operational rules that can describe the temporal logic characteristics of discrete event systems and optimize the intelligent manufacturing system. The heap model in the max-plus algebra is an intuitive dynamic system description method that can be used to model various Tetris like systems. Each block in the model can be used to identify a single work-piece in the intelligent manufacturing process, with the goal of manufacturing a set of products in a specific order, thereby minimizing the total manufacturing time. In this paper, the heap method based on max-plus algebra is used to model and analyse discrete manufacturing processes involving multiple devices and tasks. The research addresses both rigid heaps, which do not impose restrictions on the order of processing objects, and complex rigid heaps, which also allow for flexible processing object order. To enhance the analytical accuracy in scenarios involving machining tasks comprising intricate stacks of rigid heaps, an enhanced 3D heap modelling method is proposed. This approach aims to improve the production scheduling outcome. Moreover, by investigating non-rigid heaps with limited processing object order, the proposed method is compared with the simulated annealing algorithm in the field of production scheduling, and further analysis was conducted. Finally, a comprehensive analysis is presented to identify the applicable fields for the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method of Phase Equilibrium Mass Fraction Based on Pre-training RoBERTa Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Phase equilibrium plays a crucial role in various industries such as chemical, petroleum, and pharmaceutical. However, conventional methods for predicting gas-liquid equilibrium have limited applicability and require specialized knowledge in chemistry. To address this issue, we propose a gas-liquid equilibrium prediction model based on pre-trained RoBERTa model. The model accurately predicts the mass fraction of liquid($x 1$) and gas(y1) of component 1, and R2 reaches 0.8776, which shows that it has high accuracy. The performance metrics on the test set, including mean square error (MSE), root mean square error (RMSE), and average absolute error (MAE), stand at 0.0126,0.1124 and 0.0715, respectively, further affirming the model’s precision. Notably, our model only needs to input smiles codes of two substances and the pressure and temperature of the reaction to make predictions, significantly lowering the prediction threshold. And it can be used in a wide range of temperature and pressure conditions of the water system.

articleTitle: Automatic Image Acquisition and Matching in Control System of Near-Field Beam Shaping
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the high power laser system of inertial Confinement fusion (ICF), in order to improve the safe operation flux of the system, near-field beam shaping is necessary to output the laser beam with uniform and smooth intensity distribution. Therefore, how to use optical control systems to automatically and efficiently accomplish near-field beamforming is an important issue. The optical control system based on liquid crystal spatial light modulator can control the beam shape and intensity distribution in real time. The control system of near-field beam shaping algorithm mainly includes the modules of light path control, image loading on liquid crystal spatial light modulator, Charge Coupled Device (CCD) nearfield light spot perception and image processing. There is a lot of data exchange between those modules. In the laser system, the manual operation mainly involves two parts: one is the interaction and data exchange between different modules. In the past work, the image data is collected by the operator on different devices, and then the compensation image is calculated on the computing device, and finally loaded into the display device. The whole process is complex, tedious and repetitive. The other is the image matching of input image on spatial light modulator and near-field light spot. This work requires staff to manually match feature points on computing equipment, and the accuracy of matching is difficult to guarantee, which is very time-consuming and labor-intensive. This paper will address the above problems and propose a distributed network architecture to connect different devices in near-field beam shaping and carry out image acquisition from them. In addition, a new image matching algorithm is proposed to extract and match the feature points of input image on spatial light modulator and near-field light spot. It enables the compensation algorithm to be completed automatically to avoid manual operation.

articleTitle: An Integrated Learning Model for Online Performance Prediction Using LightGBM and Tabnet Fusion Model for Large Laser Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Performance prediction is a crucial aspect of ensuring optimal facility operation and maintenance across diverse fields. Although deep learning algorithms have found many applications in several industries, their applicability in tabular data mining that integrates multiple parameter types has remained somewhat limited. To address this gap, this research proposes the introduction of an integrated learning model premised on practical business scenarios, featuring data cleaning, and well-grounded feature engineering methods. Specifically, the study employs the LightGBM and Tabnet fusion model to overcome inefficiencies associated with traditional integrated learning techniques like XGBoost and GBDT. Furthermore, a recursive feature elimination approach is implemented to reduce redundancy during model construction, culminating in the improved online performance prediction. The model developed in this study has demonstrated a 32.66% reduction in prediction deviation compared to traditional manual prediction methods in simulations on large laser facilities. These findings underscore the significance of this integrated learning model in enhancing predictive accuracy, which is a critical component of optimal facility management.

articleTitle: Oblique Vision Perspective Conversion-Based Scene Matching Navigation Scheme For UAVs
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Scene matching navigation is an effective localization method for UAVs(Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) in denied environments, however, most of the existing studies require the optical axis of the on-board camera to be perpendicular to the ground. In fact, most of the acquired images are oblique visions due to the constraints of the environment and the UAV flight attitude. With this in mind, this paper designs a new oblique vision perspective conversion method to reconstruct a vertical image map, which in turn enables effective scene matching navigation. Specifically, the designed scene matching navigation scheme contains two parts. Firstly, the captured oblique view is restored to the nadir view according to the camera’s internal and external parameters. Secondly, after completing the feature point detection and matching with the remote sensing map, the vision points can be matched with the remote sensing map without calculating the homography transformation matrix to achieve the scene matching navigation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by building the camera model in the Gazebo simulation platform. The simulation results show that the algorithm designed in this paper performs better than the scene matching navigation algorithm that only relies on the UAV oblique vision information.

articleTitle: Detection of Smoking and Phone Usage Behavior in Gas Station Scenes Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To address the safety threats posed by smoking and phone usage in petrochemical environments, we propose a behavior detection method called BDAF-YOLOv8, based on the YOLOv8 network, which integrates scene context for detecting smoking and phone usage behaviors. This method employs a dual-backbone network(DBN) to extract features, where the auxiliary branch generates reliable gradient information for the main branch, thereby resolving the information bottleneck problem. Deformable Convolutional Networks v3(DCNv3) are combined to form C2fDCNv3 for feature extraction, enhancing the feature extraction capability. Finally, adaptive spatial feature fusion(ASFF) is employed as the detection head, which enhances scale invariance and improves detection accuracy. Experimental results on a self-constructed dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed improvements. The BDAFYOLOv8 model improves the mean Average Precision (mAP@50) by 4.1% and mAP@50:95 by 4.2% compared to the original YOLOv8n network. On the publicly available VOC dataset, the proposed BDAF-YOLOv8 model achieves a 6.1% improvement in mAP@50 and a 6.7% improvement in mAP@50:95 compared to the original YOLOv8n network. These results verify the effectiveness of our improvements, demonstrating that the method can achieve real-time and accurate detection of smoking and phone usage behaviors in petrochemical scenarios.

articleTitle: An Improved Hybrid Aquila Optimizer and Pigeon-Inspired Optimization Algorithm with Its Application in PID Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To improve the optimization performance of the standard Aquila Optimizer (AO), an Improved Hybrid Aquila Optimizer and Pigeon-Inspired Optimization (IHAOPIO) algorithm based on stochastic balancing factor and Dimension-by-dimension Centroid Opposition-Based Learning (DCOBL) strategy is proposed. Wilcoxon test is introduced to statistically analyze the data of six classical benchmark functions. Compared with several other optimization algorithms, the proposed IHAOPIO algorithm has better optimization capability in accuracy. The improved algorithm is used to the PID parameter optimization of one electro-hydraulic position servo system and achieves good control effect.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Distillation-enhanced YOLOv5s-LW-att for Accurate Detection of Coal Gangue
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This study introduces a refined coal gangue recognition model, lightweight YOLOv5s-Att, which enhances image analysis through knowledge distillation. It addresses challenges in generalization, accuracy, and computational complexity in industrial settings. Firstly, multiscale linear attention mechanisms and a three-dimensional attention mechanism are integrated into the detection frameworks, substantially improving performance. Additionally, a pruning-knowledge distillation framework is proposed, and a dependency graph is used to construct pruning groupings, maximizing pruning with lossless accuracy and making it compatible with resource-limited industrial environments. Lastly, a novel CloserT knowledge distillation approach is designed to further enhance accuracy. Experimental results from a laboratory coal gangue sorting image dataset demonstrate that our algorithm not only achieves higher detection accuracy but also requires fewer computational resources compared to existing models.

articleTitle: Research on the Lateral Stability of Intelligent Vehicle Considering in Continuous or Discrete State with Different Modeling Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The applicability of vehicle lateral stability simulation model is usually ignored when intelligent vehicle path tracking. In this paper, different simulation models under continuous or discrete state are established to study. Firstly, the kinematics and dynamics models of the vehicle are established, and the dynamics model is discretized. Then, a vehicle lateral controller is designed. Finally, the simulation models in different states are established in MATLAB/Simulink to verify and compare. The simulation results show that the differential equation simulation model is not accurate when it acts on the discrete state, and its deviation is up to $\mathbf{4 7. 6 \%}$, but the state-space simulation model is more accurate. The designed vehicle lateral controller can ensure good tracking effect and driving stability when the speed is not more than $10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$, and the controller has good robustness when the speed is not more than $20 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Formation Tracking Under Event-Triggered Scheme of Multi-Agent Systems Subject to Input Saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the finite-time time-varying formation tracking (TVFT) problem for multi-agent systems. Input saturation is taken into account, which can severely limit the performance of TVFT systems. The proposed control protocol solves the finite-time formation tracking problem under input saturation and the nonlinear external disturbances. To ensure the finite-time convergence of the multi-agent system, a stabilization procedure consisting of two steps is carried out. In addition, applying event-triggered scheme to TVFT control avoids constant communication between agents and no Zeno behavior. Finally, the theoretical results of this interrogation study is demonstrated through detailed simulations.

articleTitle: Based on I/Q Signal and AI Algorithms to Identify the Unique Fingerprint of Each Mobile Phone Hardware Device
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Traditionally, to identify the unique fingerprint of each mobile phone has its limitations. These limitations cause lots of the Internet black industry chain, the internet black and gray industry caused a loss of trillions of dollars due to fraud all over the world, of which smart phones accounted for a large part in 2020. Also in Automotive sector, we want to try the unique fingerprint of each mobile phone to connect with the vehicle, so we can use mobile phone to control the vehicle such as to monitor the location of the vehicle, to start the vehicle Air Conditioning before reaching the vehicle, and to avoid leaving children or pets in the car and causing life safety. But the current technology is very hard to prevent relay attacks and controlling vehicles through mobile phones because of its limitations. Based on the I/Q signal and AI algorithms, we can correctly identify the unique fingerprint of each mobile phone hardware device, because the I/Q signals from mobile phone hardware device cannot be changed by hackers; But under the traditional method, lots of parameters which are made of fingerprint of each mobile phone can be changed. Through the combination of $I / Q$ signals and AI algorithms, we can correctly identify 95% and higher of the unique fingerprint of mobile phones. Furthermore, because we can track and identify each mobile phone hardware device, the cost of the Internet black industry chain will be much higher than before, since each hardware device costs a lot. This way may be a nice method to distinguish the Internet black industry chain.

articleTitle: Application Exploration of Digital Twin Technology in Second-Loop System of Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In response to the intelligent needs of the development of nuclear power technology in recent years, this article proposes an application exploration of a nuclear power plant secondary control system based on digital twin technology. It introduces the research on nuclear power plant technology and the development status of digital twin technology, analyzes the specific requirements of nuclear power plant secondary control system, proposes a full lifecycle application framework, and provides a feasible implementation plan. The use of cutting-edge technologies that have not been used in nuclear power plants has improved the reliability and safety of nuclear power systems, and key technologies that may be applied in the future have been elaborated.

articleTitle: Integral Sliding-mode Disturbance Observer-based Control for T-S Fuzzy Systems
