publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with stabilization for Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems with the unmatched disturbance. In this paper, an integral fuzzy switching surface function (IFSSF) containing state-dependent input matrices is used. Based on this, the integral sliding mode control (ISMC) is devised to make sure that the reachability condition is achieved for a finite period of time and the DOB for estimating the disturbance is given. The design of the Lyapunov function utilizes the properties of the membership function with the assumption that its derivatives are bounded to introduce a zero matrix, which reduce the conservatism. Finally, the applicability of the proposed method is verified by a practical example and in simulation we verify that the assumption conditions of the premise is fulfilled.

articleTitle: A Seismic Response Calculation Method Combining Support Vector Machine and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: As a major natural disaster phenomenon, earthquakes affect the safety of people’s lives and property. In order to evaluate earthquake disasters and take corresponding measures, it is extremely important to analyze their characteristics and hazards. In order to complete the classification and recognition of earthquakes, the study optimized and selected seismic data using support vector machine method after reconstructing the pulse time history of earthquakes. Based on deep neural networks, the filtered data from support vector method was trained and tested to achieve more accurate seismic response recognition. After testing, the maximum error of S-transform reconstruction is about $20 \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}$, and its error index is smaller than that of the least squares fitting method used as a comparison. The accuracy of earthquake type recognition in the training set can reach $\mathbf{9 7. 6 6 \%}$. The simulated experimental results show that the fusion of support vector machine and deep neural network can effectively extract seismic sample features and determine the type of earthquake, with high accuracy and stability, which is beneficial for further research on earthquake hazards and promoting the development of earthquake engineering.

articleTitle: Efficient Numerical Methods for Convection-Reaction-Diffusion Equations with Distributed Delay
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper constructed efficient numerical methods for solving a kind of convection-reaction-diffusion equations that have the distributed delay. In order to solve these problems, they are first converted into the equivalent reaction-diffusion form by an exponential transformation. Then the resulting problem can be discretized by the compact block boundary value methods, which are established by utilizing the compact difference method of order four in spatial direction and block boundary value methods in temporal direction, where the integral term can be discretized by compound quadrature formulas.

articleTitle: Novel Controller Design and Stability Analysis for Nonlinear multi-agent system with Time-Varying Dynamics*
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper addresses the consensus problem of nonlinear multi-agent system with fixed parameter switching. A consensus protocol for quantity limitied controller based on fixed parameter switching is proposed. The results show that the reliability and stability of the system can be improved by designing different controllers in different modes, and the stability constraint of interval hoppingis applied. The range of Lipschitz constant is extended, and the sufficient conditions for controller design are optimized. Finally, the existence of the controller is derived through the application of a three-step Linear Matrix Inequality approach, and the authenticity of the theoretical outcomes is confirmed via numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Scheduling of Prefabricated Building Construction Combining BIM and Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: With the development of digital technology, prefabricated buildings tend to be intelligent in controlling the construction process and cost. Traditional scheduling methods have been unable to meet the scheduling requirements of mass construction sites. Therefore, a scheduling solution that combines the building information model with digital twin technology is proposed. Meanwhile, the important processes on the construction site are coded and combined with the virtual model for real-time scheduling. The results showed that process 52 consumed 0.92 and 0.19 in construction section status and component category identification, respectively. Process 53 consumed 0.84 and 0.93 to determine the component location coordinates and count the available resources in the construction area, respectively. Processes 53 and 54 spent 0.66 and 0.74 on determining the component location coordinates and counting the available resources in the construction area, respectively. During the construction of process $55,0.66$ and 0.74 were spent on selecting the professional category and determining the construction floor respectively. The time spent on screening professional categories and confirming the construction floor status was 0.20 and 0.36, respectively. This indicates that the proposed scheme can accurately control the construction time of the process, and the scheduling control during the construction is more accurate, greatly improving the construction efficiency,. The method also provides technical support for the intelligent development of the construction industry.

articleTitle: A Python Course Online and Offline Hybrid Classroom Management System Combining RN and SSD
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Teaching is an important organic component of school education, and classroom management is a momentous means to realize the value of curriculum teaching and improve teaching quality. To establish a good teaching order and improve Python courses’ teaching quality, a hybrid online and offline classroom management system is constructed for Python courses by combining React Native and object detection models. This study first identifies student behavior in Python courses on the foundation of object detection models, and then constructs a hybrid online and offline classroom management system for Python courses on the foundation of the React Native framework. The results showed that compared with other models, the detection speed and average accuracy of the Single Shot MultiBox Detector model were the highest, with a detection speed of 53 and an average accuracy of 63.73%. When the number of iterations is 7000, the system has the highest accuracy in recognizing students’ listening behavior and playing mobile phone behavior, which are $\mathbf{0. 8 3 5}$ and 0.830, respectively. The accuracy of the system in recognizing students’ sleeping behavior and note taking behavior is 0.70 and 0.32, respectively. The accuracy and loss rate of the React Native framework for building systems for management are higher than those of the Cordova framework, with an accuracy rate of 98% and a loss rate of 18%. The system constructed through research can effectively improve the quality of Python course teaching and realize the value of course teaching.

articleTitle: Research of Transfer Iterative Learning Control
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The prerequisite of iterative learning control (ILC) algorithm limits the parameters in the control system keep invariant in each repeated turns. Or a new learning has to be restart from beginning. So a large number of wastes and time consumption will be inevitably due to multiple iterations. If there is only a small change in the working conditions or one parameter of control system, the whole structure and nature still keep unchanged. So, the control knowledge data and learning experience obtained in original ILC process could be transferred into the new ILC system via knowledge inheriting and transforming. In this paper, a transfer ILC approach for the systems with different inertia time constant is proposed. The control value sequence obtained in the ILC of original system is decomposed into a continuous combination of multiple pulse inputs with different amplitudes. And the initial control value sequence of ILC in the new system can be determined one by one according to the way of pulse combination matching. As a result, the initial error could be reduced. Moreover, learning gain might also be regulated according to the error convergent data in the original ILC process, in which a quicker learning speed can be presented in the process of new learning. Consequently, higher start, higher slope and higher precision could be obtained in transfer ILC. The simulation proves the effect of transfer ILC approach.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection Algorithm for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Multifaceted Feature Information Extraction and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) image object detection has been widely applied in security and disaster relief and other aspects. For the sake of solving the problem of many small objects, this paper proposes a Multifaceted feature information extraction and fusion algorithm (MFIEF). Firstly, the multi-information feature extraction convolution module (MFECM) is adopted, which retains more small object feature information and surrounding spatial information. Secondly, the optimized FPN structure (OFPN) is used, the fusion of horizontal and vertical information avoids the loss of information, and the addition of lightweight attention convolution module (LACM) reduces the number of parameters while improving attention to key object information. The experimental results on the VisDrone datasets demonstrate that the MFIEF algorithm achieves a obvious improvement in performance compared to the benchmark algorithm. Specifically, the mAP@0.5 value of MFIEF is 9.7 percentage points higher, while the mAP@0.5:0.95 value of MFIEF is 6.7 percentage points higher than the benchmark algorithm. These findings highlight the superior performance of MFIEF in object detection tasks on the VisDrone datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Ships for Collision Avoidance Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In this paper, the artificial potential field method is adopted simultaneously by own ship and target ships for collision avoidance. The relative positions of ships, ship domains (four areas: Safe zone, Negotiation Zone, Emergency Avoidance Zone and Prohibited Zone), time at closest point of approach and distance at closest point of approach are utilized to analysis the encounter situations and construct a ship’s danger assessment function. Corresponding evasive actions are taken after determining the roles of each vessel according to COLREGS. The stand-on ship shall keep her course and speed and the give-away ship shall take early and substantial action to keep well clear. Four typical encounter situations including head-on, crossing (stand-on or give-away), and overtaking are simulated. The simulation results vividly demonstrate the evasive behaviors adopted by ships when dealing with collision scenarios, aligning well with COLREGS. The distance between ships and the heading angle offset during the encounter show the results by this method.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Low-Carbon Comprehensive Control System Based on End-to-End Cloud Synergy
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In recent years, with the “dual-carbon” strategy deeply rooted in people’s hearts, the integrated control system of low-carbon facilities in smart cities has been paid more and more attention to, and the research on it is very necessary. The research and development of intelligent low-carbon city integrated control system can provide more intelligent, efficient, safe, environmentally friendly and cost-effective services for the city, which is of great significance for the sustainable and intelligent development of the city. The purpose of this paper is to explore the specific realization method of the intelligent low-carbon city integrated control system, and to propose an innovative and practical solution for the integration of Internet of Things devices. This research provides strong support for the development of smart cities by synthesizing IoT technologies, intelligent control algorithms and control management systems to achieve synergistic operation between different facilities in cities, minimize energy consumption, reduce carbon emissions, and improve the efficiency of urban operations.

articleTitle: Design of a College Student Employment Guidance Platform Based on Spark Framework and FP Growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The issue of employment for college graduates will continue to become one of the main social contradictions facing China. This year’s government work report has placed more emphasis on promoting employment for young people, especially college graduates. To further solve the problem of employment difficulties for college graduates, a research proposes the design of a college student employment guidance platform based on the Spark framework and frequent pattern growth method. This study chose to build a college student employment guidance platform based on the Spark framework to complete modules such as data collection and keyword extraction, and used the frequent pattern growth algorithm to complete the data processing module. According to the results, the maximum quantity of association rules is generated when the minimum support is 0.1. The minimum quantity of association rules is generated when the minimum support is 0.3. The frequent pattern growth algorithm runs for a minimum support count of 0.400 on the Accents and Mushroom datasets, with a minimum running time of 9 seconds and 6 seconds, respectively. The method proposed in the study effectively improves the speed and quality of job recommendations on the college student employment guidance platform.

Author Keywords: Career Guidance Platform for College Students

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved DBSCAN and Its Application in Augmented Reality Inspection System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Traditional substation inspection system has the problems of low inspection accuracy and low inspection efficiency. In this paper, an image recognition algorithm based on improved DBSCAN clustering is proposed. Firstly, the U-Net segmentation algorithm is adopted to preprocess the images. Then, the image feature points are matched by AKAZE algorithm. Finally, the adaptive parameter selection method and the concept of parameter density are utilized to improve the DBSCAN clustering algorithm, and the image features are input into the improved DBSCAN clustering algorithm for feature point clustering, and finally the image recognition is realized based on the clustering results. The experimental results show that the $F 1$ index value of the proposed recognition algorithm is 0.9672, which is 0.2174,0.1903 and 0.1556 higher than the traditional YOLOv4 algorithm, CURE parallelization algorithm and K-means algorithm, respectively. Moreover, the running time of the proposed algorithm is only 96 s, which is lower than the other three algorithms. In practical application, it is found that the proposed algorithm can improve the inspection accuracy and efficiency of the augmented reality substation inspection system, and the inspection effect is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Adaptive Output Feedback Control for 2D TORA System Based on Velocity Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The typical underactuated system two-dimensional translational oscillator with rotational actuator (2D TORA) that consist of two unactuated translational carts and an actuated rotational eccentric ball which acts as its control input. As an extension of TORA system, the 2D TORA system is more general, meanwhile, the dynamic characteristics of this system makes it challenging to design a proper control scheme. It is very important to realize the accurate positioning of payloads in special application environment. In this paper, an adaptive output feedback controller is proposed to realize all state variables positioning. Specifically, in order to solve the matter of uncertain friction and unknown disturbance, an adaptive method for unknown friction coefficient is designed. Moreover, we come up with a velocity observer to calculate the angular velocity instead of differentiating the output signals. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, the state convergence and stability of the 2D TORA system are analysed. Finally, simulation test results exhibit that the presented control method is effective.

articleTitle: Pricing Optimizations of Insurance Products Based on Risk Model Under Surrender
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The high surrender rate of insurance products brings huge financial pressure and serious reputation risk to insurance companies. In this scenario, how to price insurance products is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper establishes a risk model with random policy arrival and surrender. The ruin probability, the upper bound of ruin probability, and the safety loading factor given the upper bound of ruin probability are obtained from the new risk model, which optimizes the pricing of premium for insurance products. The results will serve efficiently to the risk evaluations on insurance products and achieve stable operations of insurance companies.

articleTitle: Research on Loan Default Risk Prediction Methods Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Traditional statistical inference and machine learning models have been widely utilized in the task of predicting loan default risk. However, these approaches neglect the unique relationships between financial entities, leading to the loss of valuable information between entities and significantly impacting the accuracy of default risk prediction. To address these challenges, this study proposes a graph neural network model for predicting loan default risk: initially converting the raw tabular structure of loan records into a loan data graph; subsequently employing a graph sampling learning module to extract information from the loan data graph; and ultimately achieving precise prediction of default risk through a default prediction module. The proposed method in this paper offers a novel perspective for forecasting loan default, emphasizing the crucial importance of capturing relationships between financial entities. Furthermore, a novel node aggregation technique distinct from other graph neural networks is introduced in this study, capable of extracting more meaningful information from the loan data graph, thus enabling more accurate prediction of default risk. The efficacy of the proposed model is verified through extensive experimentation on actual datasets. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the submodule, while baseline comparison experiments indicating the model’s superior performance.

articleTitle: Knowledge Extraction Model Based on Semi-automatic Annotation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The knowledge graph is widely used in intelligent question answering, recommendation systems, and medical treatment, constructed using triples (h, r, t). A key step in building a knowledge graph is transforming data into triples (knowledge extraction). However, knowledge extraction from unstructured Chinese text faces challenges like insufficient training data, low manual labeling efficiency, and low accuracy of traditional models. To address these, this paper proposes a knowledge extraction model with semi-automatic annotation, consisting of annotation, extraction, and fusion modules. Experiments on four public datasets show that the proposed model significantly improves annotation efficiency and dataset reliability, with F1 scores eight times higher than traditional methods.

articleTitle: JavaLLM: A Fine-Tuned LLM for Java Programming Education
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into education marks a significant advancement toward personalized and adaptive learning environments, particularly in programming education. Addressing the limitations of existing LLMs in specialized domains like Java programming, this paper introduces JavaLLM — a model specifically tailored for Java programming education. Built upon a robust codeLLM and fine-tuned using extensive, high-quality Java-focused datasets, JavaLLM demonstrates superior performance in code generation and Java-specific question answering. Through rigorous evaluation and iterative refinement, JavaLLM facilitates a transformative classroom experience, enhancing the quality of teaching and enabling a personalized learning journey for students in Java programming courses. This innovation paves the way for smarter, more tailored educational approaches, leveraging AI’s generative capabilities to meet the evolving demands of modern education.

articleTitle: Improved CNN Networks for Fault Diagnosis Based on Imaging Multi-dimensional Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach for intelligent fault diagnosis of equipment by integrating Multivariate Variational Modal Decomposition (MVMD) with Symmetric Dot Plot (SDP) to create a Multivariate Symmetric Dot Plot (M-SDP) for multi-channel time series data. Unlike previous studies focused solely on single-channel signals, this method processes multivariate signals using deep learning algorithms. MVMD extracts dominant subcomponents from multiple sensors, which are then represented within the M-SDP image. The structural similarity index (SSIM) is used to optimize M-SDP parameters for distinguishing between fault states. Additionally, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is incorporated into a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), creating the CBAM-CNN approach. This proposed method, validated using gearbox data from Southeast University, demonstrates higher diagnostic accuracy and stability compared to other signal-to-image methods.

articleTitle: Position-Based Visual Servoing of a Dual-Arm System for Aerial Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper presents a new position-based visual servoing (PBVS) scheme for an aerial manipulator system, which consists of a hexacopter and two multi-joint arms. The dynamics of the aerial manipulator are derived by EulerLagrange formulations. A YOLOv5-based target detection algorithm is applied using a D435i depth camera to provide real-time and accurate pixel information as well as depth information of the target. The relative position between the aerial manipulator and the target can be determined by coordinate transformation. Because the movement of the manipulator will induce disturbance to the hexacopter, a selfbalancing motion control strategy is employed in the servo grasping process to suppress the disturbance. This approach can enhance the stability of the system, making the PBVS scheme feasible for the grasping process. In order to accomplish the grasping task, the left arm performs as the master arm, while the right arm serves as the slave arm for cooperative manipulation. Finally, the simulation environment is built in Robot Operating System (ROS), and the effectiveness of the proposed servo scheme is verified through ROS simulation.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control for Manipulator Considering Nonlinear Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: To mitigate the impreciseness in joint tracking control for manipulator systems with input saturation due to external disturbance, parameter uncertainty and dead zone nonlinearity, a fast non-singular terminal sliding mode active disturbance rejection control (FNTSM-ADRC) method was proposed. The active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) framework served as the basis for the proposed controller’s design. An improved extended state observer (ESO) was introduced for feedback compensation to observe and estimate the lumped disturbance. Furthermore, the control law was designed by using the fast non-singular terminal sliding mode (FNTSM) combined with the improved reaching law, which accelerated the speed of the state reaching the sliding mode surface (SMS) and the better demand for chattering reduced and control precision can be achieved. Finally, the system stability was verified by the Lyapunov stability criterion. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed tracking algorithm exhibits better control performance as well as anti-interference capability.

articleTitle: MPPT Research for Switched Reluctance Wind Turbine based on Variable Universe Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Taking the three-phase 6/4 switched reluctance wind turbine as an example, for the uncertainty of wind energy in the wind power generation system, it is difficult to achieve the maximum power point tracking quickly and effectively. This paper adopts the variable universe idea to optimize the traditional fuzzy controller, and adopts the current chopper control for the switched reluctance generator to regulate the speed. The simulation results show that the designed variable universe fuzzy controller has better tracking effect than the traditional fuzzy controller and can effectively reduce the system steady state error, so that the switched reluctance wind power generation system can more accurately achieve the maximum power point tracking.

articleTitle: Autism Classification Based on Multi-atlas Graph Attention Networks and Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by significant impairments in brain function. However, current research primarily focuses on extracting brain network features in Euclidean space, often overlooking the critical topological properties of brain networks. Moreover, the reliance on a single brain atlas for segmenting brain regions restricts the utilization of complementary insights provided by multiple atlases. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel approach called multi-atlas graph attention networks and metric learning (MAGM). Our method utilizes two brain atlases to define brain regions more comprehensively. We then implement a metric learning-based graph attention network to extract discriminative features for ASD classification. Additionally, we propose a dynamic attention fusion mechanism to effectively integrate features obtained from both atlases. The effectiveness of our MAGM model is demonstrated through classification results on the ABIDE dataset. Our method not only improves the classification performance but also identifies crucial brain regions associated with ASD.

articleTitle: Anti-Attack Control of Positive Cyber-Physical Systems Using Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the state-feedback and observer-based feedback control for positive cyber-physical systems. A novel positive anti-attack controller is first proposed for the systems by introducing a switched control strategy. By developing observer technique for cyber-physical systems, a positive controller equipped with dynamic output-feedback approach is refined to estimate unavailable output. Under the designed controllers, the positive and stable with $L_{1}$-gain performance are reached. Then, a matrix decomposition method is employed to design observer and controller gains. All presented conditions are described via linear programming. Finally, an illustrative example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed design.

articleTitle: The Optimization of TSK Regression Model by FCM, Droprule and Lion
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: TSK (Takagi-Sugeno-Kang) fuzzy system is widely used because of its good approximation performance. In order to effectively optimize the regression problem of TSK fuzzy system, based on the recently proposed MBGD-RDA (mini-batch gradient descent with regularization, DropRule and AdaBound) algorithm, we also propose the FCM-Lion (Fuzzy c means with DropRule and Lion) algorithm. The algorithm uses FCM to cluster the input samples to obtain the required number of rules, thus avoiding the problem of rule explosion caused by the shared rule base. In addition, it combines the latest proposed lion (EvoLved Sign Momentum) optimizer to replace the AdaBound algorithm, becouse Lion uses sign function to ignore the length of the gradient and only retains the direction of the gradient, thus playing a regularization effect in optimization process. And since lion only maintains a momentum information, it consumes less memory, so our paper combines it with DropRule to further accelerate parameter optimization. The algorithm we proposed is compared with other four optimization algorithms to prove its superiority by experimenting on six regression datasets with different sizes and dimensions. The results show that the RMSEtest of FCM-Lion is basically the smallest, and the training time is lower than the other four algorithms, which proves the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Satellite Dynamics Modeling and Characteristic Analysis Based on Modelica
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: As a complex system with high risk, high investment, high precision and high benefit, satellite works in the harsh space environment for a long time, which puts forward higher requirements for the reliability of satellite power system. With the development of modelling and computer technology, mathematical modelling and computer simulation have an increasingly significant impact on product design and have become important methods in developing satellite control systems. This paper aims to use the multi-domain modelling language Modelica to simulate a satellite containing a large-mass rotating payload bay and to study the dynamic coupling between the satellite payload bay and the platform bay, which lays a foundation for the design of the subsequent attitude control system.

articleTitle: Design and Kinematic Modeling of Wrist-Inspired Joints
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Discrete manipulators perform tasks by moving through discrete positions or postures, offering high precision and simple structures. However, they encounter challenges related to limited operational space. In recent years, soft manipulators with high flexibility and compliance have been developed, but most of them feature intricate structures, making it difficult to establish accurate models for them. To tackle these challenges, a wrist-inspired joint is designed in this paper that combines the high stiffness of discrete manipulators with the flexibility of soft manipulators. In detail, first, an anti-parallelogram mechanism, forms a basis for the design, creating a wrist-inspired joint with three parallel links. The joint enables pitch and yaw motions, mimicking the flexibility of human wrist joints. Especially, meticulously designed connecting rods effectively prevent interference between moving parts. On this basis, the kinematic models of wrist-inspired joints are established, encompassing both forward and inverse kinematic models. Finally, the effectiveness of established kinematic models is verified through experiments conducted on a self-built platform.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Method for Railway Collapse-related Accident Summary Text
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: As China advances the digitization and intelligence of its railway system, it has become crucial to automatically extract critical information from text data concerning railway collapse-related accidents. To address this problem, this research uses the RoBERTa-CNN-BiLSTM-CRF fusion model to extract five types of information, such as accident time and route. This model combines the RoBERTa model’s ability to capture deep semantic information, the CNN model’s advantages in extracting local features, the BiLSTM model’s ability to enhance contextual semantic dependencies, and the CRF model’s ability to model label dependencies in sequence annotation tasks, thereby achieving more accurate named entity recognition. This research uses a self-collected railway collapse-related accident data set to verify the model’s effectiveness. It adopts the Micro-Averaging method as the evaluation index. The fusion model’s MicroP, MicroR, and MicroF values reach $94.72 \%, 95.76 \%$, and 95.24%, respectively. Experimental results show that the fusion model is an effective technical means for processing railway collapse-related accident text.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Based on Feature Fusion and Channel Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Remote sensing small target detection can accurately detect small-scale targets in remote sensing images. It is valuable for military reconnaissance and civilian image recognition. However, there are some challenges in small target detection in remote sensing images. For instance, small targets have limited feature information, making them difficult to locate. To address these issues, we propose a remote sensing small target algorithm based on feature fusion and channel attention. This algorithm aims to improve small object detection by constructing a strong feature module and fusing the receptive fields of different levels of the shallow feature map. The two shallow feature maps, which are extracted by the backbone network, are processed by the feature enhancement module, resulting in an increase in the extracted small target feature information. The feature fusion module is created using the feature map extracted from the backbone network, and the feature information of small targets is significantly enhanced after passing through the feature fusion module. To capture small target features more accurately, a new channel attention mechanism is designed. The output consists of three feature maps, and small target detection is performed on these three feature maps. Experimental results demonstrate that on the SIMD dataset and the WiderFace dataset, the proposed algorithm achieves a high average accuracy level and exhibits good robustness.

articleTitle: Seeking Bipartite Formation of Networked Agent Systems Subject to Random Packet Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This study delves into the bipartite formation control issue in networked agent systems (NASs) that are subject to random packet loss. The interactions among agents that have both cooperation and competition. The randomness of packet loss is captured by Bernoulli random variables, which introduce the potential for communication breakdowns between proximal agents at each time interval. This inherent unreliability can trigger dispersion in agent behavior and system instability. To counteract these effects, an innovative and fully distributed bipartite formation control protocol is designed. By harnessing the convergence theory for infinite products of sub-stochastic matrices (SSMs), the strategy guarantees global and almost certain convergence, provided that specific algebraic prerequisites are satisfied. The paper substantiates the proposed control scheme’s effectiveness through a numerical simulation, showcasing its robustness against the backdrop of random packet loss.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Artificial Physics Optimization Algorithm Based on Two-Phase Search
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient utilization of information about elite particles in archive and instability of particle motion in the population in the multi-objective artificial physics optimization algorithm (MOAPO) in solving multiobjective optimization problems, A multi-objective artificial physics optimization algorithm based on two-phase search (TPMOAPO) is proposed. To begin with, the algorithm improves the calculation of the mass of particles, so that the strength and weakness of the particles can be accurately transformed into the corresponding masses while improving the efficiency of particle mass calculation. Next, a two-phase search strategy is proposed, which makes the algorithm have strong exploration ability in the first phase, and the second phase gradually enhances the exploitation capability with iterations, which solves the problem of instability motion of particles in the search process. Finally, the simulated binary crossover (SBX) and polynomial-based mutation (PM) operators are adopted in the archive to further enhance the search capability of the algorithm. For verifying the performance of TP-MOAPO, 21 benchmark functions were selected to compare with the classical multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithms: MOPSO, dMOPSO, SMPSO, MMOPSO, and NMPSO, and the experimental results show the superiority of TP-MOAPO in these functions.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Server Performance Data Based on Graph Convolutional Networks and TCN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Cloud computing as an emerging computing model is widely used in various industries, and servers are crucial as its infrastructure. With the increase in the demand for computing resources, the problem of server performance anomaly detection has become an important challenge in the field of cloud computing. Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of existing server performance anomaly detection, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) and TCN network incorporating global attention mechanism. Firstly, the spatial features and attributes of the server are mapped into a graph structure, and the GCN network is used to fuse the graph structure data and the time series data in order to capture the relationship between nodes and generate the time series data integrating the topological information; subsequently, the processed data is input into the TCN structure integrating the global attention mechanism to extract its local feature information. Finally, the feature vectors output from the TCN are mapped to the final output space through a linear layer to achieve the detection and identification of server performance anomalies. This method combines the spatial and temporal features of time series data to improve the accuracy and reliability of server performance anomaly detection. Experimental results on the open-source dataset show that all the evaluation indexes of the model proposed in the article are better than the baseline model, thus validating the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Design of ECT Hardware Circuit for Complex Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The circuit design of the capacitive tomography system is designed to achieve high-quality imaging results and has a wide range of potential for medical, industrial and scientific applications. This paper designs A set of capacitive tomography system hardware circuit for multiphase flow detection in the chemical industry, including the design of signal excitation module to realize the generation of sinusoidal AC excitation signals with adjustable amplitude and frequency. The process of $D / A$ conversion to convert digital signals into analog electrical signals should fully consider the resolution, sampling rate, signal-to-noise ratio and other factors. Select signals within A specific frequency range and amplify them through signal processing processes such as filtering and amplifying. Design small capacitance detection circuit and data acquisition module. The detection circuit needs to have high sensitivity and stability to measure small capacitance changes, and convert analog signals into digital signals through amplification and filtering and A/D conversion to transmit to the main control chip. After the demodulation program, the sensitive field information in the voltage signal is extracted, the demodulated signal is transmitted to the computer by the USB bus transmission module, and the upper computer program is written to complete the image reconstruction function and realize the multiphase flow detection in the pipeline.

articleTitle: Web Application Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: In the digital age web applications have become a staple of our daily lives due to their convenience and efficiency. It is our main form of communication, transactions and how we access information. With the abilities of web applications, we have become reliant on them for our day-to-day tasks. Although this is not inherently bad, it has become clear that web application security is a paramount tool for online use, particularly among businesses and organisations. Web application security is the practice of protecting websites, applications, and APIs from attacks. This form of security aims to ensure that web applications function smoothly and remain unhindered by cyber vandalism, data theft, and other malicious attacks. This report will explore the top three vulnerabilities highlighted by the most recent OWASP top ten vulnerabilities report, last updated in 2021. These vulnerabilities include broken access control, cryptography failures and injection attacks. Moreover, each section will highlight how these security techniques defend, can be exploited and what measures developers can take to better defend web applications. The paper addresses the future of web application security in the context of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning. It speculates on how these technologies might be integrated into security strategies to enhance threat detection and response capabilities. The concept of DevSecOps is introduced as an evolutionary approach to integrate security into the development process of web applications, emphasizing the shift towards proactive security practices. In conclusion, the paper highlights the critical nature of web application security in the digital age. It provides a detailed examination of the most pressing vulnerabilities and offers guidance on implementing effective security measures. The aim is to equip developers, security professionals, and organizations with the knowledge and tools necessary to build and maintain secure web applications, ultimately protecting them from the evolving landscape of cyber threats.

articleTitle: Multi-Parameter Optimization of VIV Energy Harvesting System Based on Black-winged Kite Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: A vortex-induced vibrations (VIV) energy harvesting circuit model based on MATLAB is proposed, and a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) method is used to operate a boost converter. Black-Winged Kite Algorithm (BKA), a metaheuristic inspired by the foraging and migratory behavior of Black-winged Kites, was employed for optimizing key parameters that affect the circuit model’s energy harvesting efficiency: load resistance, pulse width modulation (PWM) frequency, and MPPT step size. BKA’s robust search capabilities make it well-suited for optimizing within large parameter spaces. The model was trained using two types of voltage inputs: one simulating typical VIV conditions and another with strong external interference. The optimized circuit achieved a boost efficiency of up to 86.85% and a maximum power transfer efficiency of 84.80% under normal conditions, and 88.15% boost efficiency with 87.22% maximum power transfer efficiency under interference. These results demonstrate that dynamic optimization of circuit parameters can significantly enhance the performance of VIV energy harvesting systems, offering new avenues for improving VIV energy recovery.

articleTitle: Gamification for Health and Online Communities: Enhancing Medication Adherence and Emotional Well-being in Pediatric Thalassemia
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Thalassemia is an inherited disease that drastically reduces the amount of hemoglobin produced in the body and leads to severe anemia. The number of people suffering from thalassemia is as many as $\mathbf{3 0 0, 0 0 0}$, according to “The China Thalassemia Blue Paper” [1]. The impact of this life-changing disease affects children most, who usually need intensive treatment over a lifetime that includes regular blood transfusions and routine medication. Yet the stringent requirements associated with this treatment regimen combined with a lifetime of living with a chronic disease are stressful and lead to high rates of uncompliant as well as emotional stress for pediatric thalassemia patients. Direct-to-patient incentives or aspects taken from video games are two new healthcare approaches to improving drug adherence [2]. This research paper investigates the potential of gamification and online communities to improve medication adherence and bolster emotional well-being in these young patients. We propose a unique web-based platform with a mobile application that ingeniously melds a virtual pet game and an interactive community. This platform aims to create an ecosystem where pediatric thalassemia patients can be engaged, feel a sense of community, maintain discipline in following their routine lifesaving medications, and provide them with much-needed emotional support. This novel method makes it easy for children with thalassemia to enjoy their lives (equipped by play and social connectivity) instead of suffering due to the burden of managing this chronic disease, thus significantly improving their quality of life.

articleTitle: Game-Theoretic Lane Changing Method Based on Dynamic Safe Distance Strategy in the Zero-Trust Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Autonomous driving technology has advanced significantly, with lane changing being crucial for the safe operation of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs). Improper lane changes on highways can cause accidents and damage. This paper proposes a game-theoretic lane-changing method for intelligent CAVs under a zero-trust framework, focusing on highway scenarios. By using game theory to simulate strategy selection and decision-making, and incorporating a dynamic safe distance strategy, the method aims to enhance lane-changing efficiency and smoothness. The Competitive Swarm Optimization (CSO) algorithm is used to optimize game payoff matrix parameters, ensuring quick and smooth lane changes. Simulation experiments demonstrate the method’s feasibility and effectiveness, offering a new solution for safe autonomous driving in complex environments.

articleTitle: Research on a New Operating System R&D Model Based on the Open Source Community
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel operating system R&D model that integrates the advantages of the bazaar model and the cathedral model, leveraging the open-source community, and collaborating with domestic and international Linux open-source communities and organizations. The model builds a trinity R&D system encompassing global universities, enterprises, and individual enthusiasts. It conducts technical activities in over 30 cities and 50 universities worldwide, training over $\mathbf{1 0, 0 0 0}$ Linux developers. Supported by national policies, the “14th Five-Year Plan for Digital Economy Development” encourages the development of open-source communities, platforms, and projects with independent core technologies, promoting the sharing of innovative resources. The “14th Five-Year Plan and 2035 Vision Outline” emphasizes integrated R&D of general processors, cloud computing systems, and core software technologies, supporting the development of digital technology open-source communities. With these policy supports, we continuously advance operating system technology and its applications through technological innovation and open cooperation, achieving significant results in key areas such as high-end chips, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing, and successfully releasing the Kylin operating system V10 version. This paper details the design, development process, achievements, and future prospects of this R&D model.

articleTitle: DD-GNN: Graph Neural Network Based on Diffusion and Denoising Model for Link Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: For the link prediction task in knowledge graph, the existing subgraph-based representation learning method, by studying the structural characteristics of nodes in the subgraph, passes the structural information of neighbor nodes to target nodes through messages for aggregation and update, and generates a more expressive subgraph representation. Due to the large number of closed subgraphs extracted, calculating structural features for each subgraph increases the computational cost. Due to the large number of closed subgraphs extracted, calculating structural features for each subgraph increases the computational cost. There is a problem that the information contained by nodes in subgraphs is not efficient, and existing studies are not effective in filtering out invalid information, and will weaken the generated subgraph representation. Therefore, this paper proposes a new framework: DD-GNN for graph neural networks with joint diffusion model. In this paper, the computational overhead is reduced by ignoring the structural features, and the representation of closed subgraphs is directly fed into the diffusion model to effectively remove the noise, thus better enhance the representation of subgraphs. In experiments, the DD-GNN framework outperforms some baseline models on publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Cross-Modality Comprehensive Feature Aggregation Network for Road Scene Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: RGB-thermal semantic segmentation is a potential solution for reliable semantic scene understanding under adverse weather and complex lighting conditions. However, past studies have primarily focused on the design of fusion paradigms. Unfortunately, these methods have not fully considered the modality differences caused by different imaging mechanisms, thereby reducing the performance of pixel-level semantic analysis. In response to this issue, this paper proposes an innovative Cross-Modality Comprehensive Feature Aggregation Network (CFANet). This method first designs a Cross-Modality Feature Rectification Module (CFRM) to align modality differences; then, it constructs a Global-Local Fusion Module (GLF) to sharpen object edges and refine the segmentation map. Results on two urban scene understanding datasets demonstrate that CFANet can effectively aggregate multi-layer deep features and outperform existing advanced deep learning methods in scene understanding performance.

articleTitle: Robust Control of a Rotorcraft-slung-load System with Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the control problem of load trajectory tracking in the slung load system of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in the presence of unknown disturbances. We derive a coordinate-free dynamical model of the system, accounting for disturbances affecting the quadrotor. The backstepping method was used to design the controller of the quadrotor, which ensures that (i) the load accurately tracks the desired trajectory and (ii) the slung load system achieves asymptotic stability even in the presence of disturbances. Simulation and experiment results are presented to validate the controller, and the stability of the system is proven using Lyapunov stability theory.

articleTitle: Feature-Based Local Ensemble Framework for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: The use of centralized value networks is an important training method in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Existing methods usually utilize value decomposition to enable agents to achieve localized learning. However, these methods do not take into account sample efficiency, and the introduction of additional networks will also bring more computational costs. Therefore, it is necessary to introduce the ensemble idea of making full use of the replay buffer. The general ensemble learning approach is to introduce sub-models into the value network, and its application in multi-agent systems is not yet mature. In this paper, we firstly implement a multi-agent ensemble technique with locally shared parameters in the network by introducing a feature-based grouping mechanism. Secondly, we propose random and feature-based grouping principles and design a dimension reduction scheme for action-state space. Finally, our approach was evaluated on the benchmark platform, Multi-Agent Particle Environment (MPE), and compared with baseline algorithms. The results demonstrated that our method exhibited notable advantages in terms of achieving higher scores and converging rapidly.

articleTitle: Nondestructive Classification of Black Tea Grades Based on Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Symposium on Computer Science and Intelligent Control (ISCSIC)
abstract: Tea grade classification is a crucial standard in assessing tea quality, allowing for a rapid evaluation of the general quality of tea. This paper proposes a method for black tea grade classification based on hyperspectral imaging technology, chemometric algorithms, and machine learning. Standard Normal Variate (SNV) was used to preprocess the hyperspectral data. Then, correlation analysis was conducted between tea grades and chemical values to identify the chemical values that directly reflect tea grades. To reduce redundant wavelengths and improve model accuracy, Successive Projections Algorithm (SPA) and Competitive Adaptive Reweighted Sampling (CARS) were employed for secondary feature wavelength selection. Support Vector Machine (SVM) was used to establish classification models for single and multiple fused chemical values. The results show that combining hyperspectral imaging technology with machine learning can achieve excellent results in tea grade classification, with an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 8 \%}$. This method provides a theoretical basis for the rapid and non-destructive online classification of black tea grades.
